description: I'm a noob coder, absolute beginner
summary: I developed a rocket flying game where you go to the moon, come back to earth, and see the rocks you have, and history about the moon. Which teaches you the basics on the planet and some elements.
details: It uses Scratch's block type coding for the game. It has a lot of bugs that I couldn't fix due to time limits, which makes the game manual/and hard to use. My intended impact with my game is to spark a curiosity of space to people. My project is creative because I limited my usage of AI to near zero. The factors I considered the most is the difficulty of the coding language, and the time limits that I have to face.
